name: prefix_startswith_no_separator
description: Reintroduces the historical prefix-collision bug this task's reference used to have: containment is enforced via a naive norm_joined.startswith(norm_base) with NO trailing-separator check. A sibling directory that merely shares a name prefix (e.g. "/srv/data-other") is wrongly treated as being under base "/srv/data", because the string "/srv/data-other/file.txt" literally starts with the string "/srv/data". This is exactly the task-specific security near-miss a partial or naive fix of safe_join is likely to reproduce.
